commands.rationale: The Torus its owner handed over (QL's torus-native, kept by the kernel under the field's lease, Field::torus_native; the page names only its digest) sounds on one of the set's MIDI parts: the engine's node continues the owner's field from the sample it stood at, refused in words for a document that is not one, a part that plays no notes or a host built without QL's K8 node. From then on the part follows that owner (the kernel's tap, Field::set_torus_tap): each act the owner lands is struck at the owner's sample with the impulses the owner's law gave each mode, each later hand-over is taken in the last one's place, and the part's notes are the owner's: the host hands each clip note of the part over ahead of the engine, and each MIDI note sent to it at once, as the key the page's pitch→key law names for it (notes, O-I #853) at the owner's sample its frame falls on (the oi:live-engine-torus-notes event), which the page plays on the owner through the frame; the owner's act strikes the part back through the tap, and the Torus on the part strikes no note of its own. Its effects go with it (effects, the frame's own as its reading reports them): each on the frame's chain, in order, as Live's device of its kind on the chain after the Torus (Filter as Auto Filter, Dynamics as Compressor, Delay as Delay, Reverb as Reverb, as the shell's rackChainInLive places them), the engine's own device where it has one (live-engine rack_device) and said in words where it has none. The Live set's sound on the default output (live_engine_host.rs over packages/live-engine): a native audio presentation of the set its kernel owner keeps (live_set_owner.rs). It decides and writes nothing. Candidate webviews only.
commands.spec_ref: ProjectCentral/docs/1-vision/dlw/DLW.md §21.1 (Rules: every part sounds in one engine; Export Audio renders what you heard) and §21.2 (the torus is the only generator), O-I #849; docs/cradle/02-ARCHITECTURE.md §5/§12

commands.rationale: The Torus's effects as the frame now holds them (effectsLaw.ts EffectsState, as its reading reports them) on the part following the Torus's owner: each effect on the frame's chain, in order, as Live's device of its kind after the Torus (Filter as Auto Filter, Dynamics as Compressor, Delay as Delay, Reverb as Reverb, the shell's rackChainInLive mapping), the engine's own device where it has one (live-engine rack_device: Reverb at the frame's Decay, Compressor at the corpus's values) and said in words where it has none; each device made as before keeps its state, and Export Audio puts each chain there again at the frame the engine did. Refused in words for what is not the frame's effects and while no part follows the Torus. The Live set's sound on the default output (live_engine_host.rs over packages/live-engine): a native audio presentation of the set its kernel owner keeps (live_set_owner.rs). It decides and writes nothing. Candidate webviews only.
